items.statement: The investigation explicitly proposes at least two chemically distinct hypotheses and a finite, documented candidate-generation/discrimination strategy.
items.expected: Hypotheses, candidate IDs, generation coverage and discrimination tests are recorded before the final claim.

items.statement: Candidates are deduplicated, optimized and stationary-point validated with failures retained in the report.
items.expected: A candidate-specific validation table distinguishes validated minima from failed or incomplete calculations.

items.statement: The evidence supports a hydration-dependent structural reorganization with onset at n=3 in the isolated-cluster series.
items.expected: The reported selected structures and observables support this onset without relying on an undisclosed author-route assertion.

items.statement: The n-dependent OH spectral evolution includes a pronounced hydrogen-bond-sensitive change around n=3.
items.expected: Computed assignments are compared to the supplied public bands and used as independent evidence.
